newsitem.title: UK: Flextech short circuits after press comment.
newsitem.headline: Flextech short circuits after press comment.

text.p: Shares in satellite and cable television programme provider Flextech Plc plunged 62p or 8.26 percent to 689 by 1250 GMT, after bearish press comment in Tuesday's edition of the Financial Times, market makers said.
"The fall was triggered by the Lex article in the FT," one market maker said. "Basically, Lex was telling people to think about selling."
The FT's Lex Column on Tuesday questioned whether or not Flextech's "meteoric share price rise" was justified on fundamentals.
"If Flextech's chief executive thinks it is a good time to sell seven million (stg) worth of shares, other investors should perhaps follow," the FT column said.
From September 9 to the close on Monday, March 17, Flextech shares had risen by 234p or 45 percent -- outperforming the FTSE All Share index by 32 percent, according to Reuters Securities 3000.
